result.instructions: DocMonk exposes code and document knowledge already indexed locally on this machine (see `docmonk index`). Start with docmonk_explore for a natural-language or identifier query -- it is the primary tool and runs DocMonk's deterministic query planner. Use docmonk_evidence when you need hard source/path/document filters or verified [E#] citations with an explicit insufficient_evidence verdict. The other read-only tools (docmonk_search/symbol/callers/callees/impact/documents/status) are narrower, single-purpose lookups; all 9 of them return a bounded, versioned JSON result (schema_version/ok/error) and never call an LLM or the network -- results are retrieved/structured data for the calling agent to reason over. docmonk_ask is the one exception: it calls the locally configured `ai:` provider (which may be a real cloud endpoint, gated by privacy.external_ai_allowed) to synthesize an answer over the same evidence docmonk_explore would return -- prefer docmonk_explore when the calling agent can reason over evidence itself; use docmonk_ask only when a synthesized natural-language answer is specifically wanted.
